provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The depth file path is hardcoded to a workshop user's machine (L10); the comment at L8 mentions an fdir variable that does not actually exist in this script.
audit_member_text: Portability/interface defect at L8-L10: the comment asks the user to provide a folder path, but no fdir input exists and np.loadtxt uses one developer-specific absolute path, so the script fails on other machines unless source code is edited.

base_member_text: Colorbar label 'Bathymetry (m)' (L36) describes -dep values (negative down), consistent with the MATLAB '-depth (m)' label, but the sign convention is not stated in the file.

audit_member_text: Matplotlib pcolor at L29 uses center-length x/y vectors with an equally shaped dep array; depending on the installed Matplotlib shading default/version this can either discard a boundary row/column or reject same-sized coordinates, and no shading mode is specified.
